method: Production bundle in JSDOM: compact card overview, disclosure, batch edit, filter totals, metadata save and correction; no browser layout engine
checks: single batch has one quantity, no recipe calculation, opens and closes
expired stock remains in physical total
two batches show combined amount and partial expiry; second edit targets second batch
location filter shows matching quantity, with full total in detail
search ignores case and supports empty results
unknown date and absent location have clear labels
zero stock does not receive expired-stock alert
convertible units are combined; incompatible units remain separate
metadata edit saves intended location and retains stock
stock correction remains accessible from expanded card
category inventory also uses compact cards
inventory navigation preserves recipe availability and stored data
